Title: US Gov Virginia Availability Zones now generally available

Body.Content:
Availability Zones in US Gov Virginia are made up of 3 unique physical locations within a datacenter region, providing US government customers with additional options for high availability, performance and resilience.  Availability Zones provide redundancy and logical isolation of services, to ensure mission-critical customer services and workloads are available anytime and anywhere.

Learn more.
